decisions.reason: It extends the firm’s core energy-pricing and calculation offer, was given its own webpage, and fits the strategy of adding higher-value analytical tools to the central platform.
A gas tariff comparison tool is very close to the firm’s established utility-market services, and its standalone web presentation suggests clear commercial commitment and likely customer relevance.
A regional electricity tariff calculator is tightly aligned with the firm’s core billing and tariff expertise and is likely to be retained as a standard platform component for utility customers.

Although it was only mentioned on the website and may overlap with other tariff tools, it still builds on the established offer and a multi-model product line usually indicates an intention to refine rather than withdraw.
The area definition tool supports the location-based logic behind several other products, and its own webpage suggests it is viewed as an enabling module within the broader platform.

This product line fits the firm’s tariff-comparison niche, but because it was only mentioned on the website and overlaps with other comparison and calculator products, its withdrawal risk is somewhat higher than the others.
